title: NetrunnerEngineCard
description: Card definition as pure data. Effect IR is the executable language; unknown IR nodes fail closed at load time.

requiresProtectingIce.description: Only servers protected by at least one piece of ice are legal run targets (Kompromat).

requiresUnrezzedIce.description: Only servers protected by at least one unrezzed piece of ice are legal run targets (High-Stakes Job).

bonusAccessUnusedMuCapped.description: Deep Data Mining: on successful R&D breach, bonus access = min(unused MU, this cap).

iceRezAdditionalCostEqualsPrintedRezCost.description: During this run, Corp pays additional rez cost equal to each ice's printed rez cost (Running Interference).

transferHostedCreditsToEventCredits.description: Move hosted credits on the run source into run eventCredits (Debbie).

onRunEnd.description: Effect IR fired when the run ends (success or not), sourced on the run event/ability card.

onFirstEncounterThisRun.description: Compile: the first time you encounter ice during this run, resolve this effect.

icebreakerStrengthBonusIfGripLte.description: Pushing the Envelope: if grip size ≤ gripMax when the run begins, each installed icebreaker has +bonus strength until the run ends.

onEncounterMayInstallProgramFromGripIgno.description: Diana's Hunt: whenever you encounter ice during this run, you may install 1 program from grip ignoring all costs.

trashProgramsInstalledThisWayOnRunEnd.description: Diana's Hunt: when the run ends, trash all programs installed via onEncounterMayInstallProgramFromGripIgnoringCosts.

bypassEncountersRemaining.description: Bypass the next N ice encounters this run (Feint).

bypassInnermostEncounter.description: When encountering the innermost ice protecting the attacked server, bypass it (Spear Phishing).

bypassSecondEncounterForClickIfThreat.description: Threat N → at the second ice encounter this run, Runner may spend [click] to bypass (S-Dobrado).

redirectApproachArchivesToHq.description: After passing Archives ice, change attacked server to HQ and approach HQ (Maintenance Access).

mayRedirectApproachArchivesToHqOrRdPayin.description: After passing Archives ice, Runner may pay this many stealth credits to change attacked server to HQ or R&D and approach that server (Baker).

blockCreditPoolSpendAndLose.description: While this run is active, Runner cannot spend or lose credits from their credit pool (Aircheck).

shredPreventFirstEndTheRun.description: Shred: first Corp end-the-run is prevented unless Corp reveals and trashes X random HQ (X = root size).

skipBreach.description: On successful run, skip breaching the attacked server (e.g. Chastushka replace-breach).

preventAllDamageThisRun.description: The Noble Path: whenever the Runner would take damage during this run, prevent all of that damage.

immolationScriptAccessReplace.description: Immolation Script: once this run, when accessing faceup ice in Archives, may instead trash 1 rezzed copy of that ice.

blankAttackedServerRoot.description: During this run, cards in the root of the attacked server lose all abilities (Light the Fire!).

derezProtectingIceOnRunBegin.description: When this run begins, derez 1 ice protecting the attacked server (Window of Opportunity).

mayRezEventDerezzedIceOnRunEndIgnoreCost.description: When this run ends, Corp may rez the ice derezzed by this event, ignoring all costs (Window of Opportunity).

forbidCorpRezIceDuringRun.description: While this run is active, the Corp cannot rez ice (Blackmail).

accessTrashFree.description: Demolition Run-class: during this run, access → trash accessed card for 0¢.

briberyFirstIceAdditionalRezEqualsX.description: Bribery: first unrezzed ice approached this run costs +X to rez (X = play cost chosen).

accessFromBottomOfRd.description: Showing Off: when breaching R&D, access from the bottom instead of the top.

trashFirstFullyBrokenSubtype.description: Knifed/Spooned/Forked: first time you fully break ice of this subtype during the run, trash that ice.

onPassIceMayTrashEqualStrengthToTrashIce.description: Prey: once during this run, when you pass ice, may trash installed cards equal to its strength to trash that ice.

trashFirstNonAgendaAccessCorpMayPayRezOr.description: Credit Crash: trash the first non-agenda card accessed during this run at no cost; Corp may spend credits equal to its rez or play cost to prevent.

redirectSuccessChooseHqOrRd.description: Omar Keung: if the run would be declared successful, Runner chooses HQ or R&D as the attacked server for the remainder of that run.

faction.description: NRDB faction_code (e.g. jinteki, criminal, neutral-runner). Used for faction-matching abilities (Storgotic Resonator).

advancementRequirementEqualsRunnerGrip.description: When true, advancement requirement equals the number of cards in the Runner grip (Blood in the Water).

advancementRequirementReductionPerTag.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per Runner tag (Freedom of Information).

advancementRequirementReductionPerCoreDa.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per core damage the Runner has taken this game (Ontological Dependence).

advancementRequirementReductionPerBadPub.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by per × Corp bad publicity, counting at most max BP (Regulatory Capture).

recurringCreditsMaxEqualsRunnerLink.description: Net Police: recurring credit pool max equals the Runner's link when refilled/rezzed.

recurringCreditsMaxEqualsVirusCounters.description: Pheromones: recurring credit pool max equals virus counters on this card when refilled / when virus changes.

startingHandSize.description: Identity: draw this many cards for the starting hand instead of 5 (Andromeda: 9).

playRequiresVirusCounterPlacedOnProgramT.description: Surge: play only if you placed ≥1 virus counter on a program this turn.

onHardwareInstall.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs any hardware (including this card). Replicator; uses turn.lastHardwareInstalledId.

requireLostClickToBreakThisRun.description: Zed 1.0: subroutine resolves only if the Runner lost a click to break a subroutine this run.

breaksSubtype.description: Ice subtype to break, or "*" for AI.

breakViaPaidAbilityOnly.description: When true, standard credit break is disabled; breaks only via paidAbilities (e.g. Revolver).

breakMaxSubs.description: Max subroutines per paid break ability use (default 1).

breakCreditsDiscountPerInstalledSubtype.description: Reduce breakCredits by amount × count of installed cards with subtype (Tremolo: cybernetic).

breakRequiresAttackingMark.description: Standard credit break only while attacking the mark (Tunnel Vision).

breakRequiresIceStrengthLte.description: Wyrm-class: only break when encountered ice strength ≤ this.

breakRequiresIceSubtypeCountGte.description: Sadyojata / Deva: only break ice that has at least this many subtypes.

breakRequiresIceExactSubroutineCount.description: Vamadeva: only break ice with exactly this many printed subroutines.

breakRequiresIceRezCostGte.description: Aghora / Deva: only break ice that has a rez cost of this many or greater.

breakPreventsCardAccessForRun.description: Eater: after using this breaker to break a subroutine, Runner cannot access cards for the remainder of the run.

oncePerTurn.description: Ability usable at most once per turn (Madani install).

creditsFromStealthOnly.description: When true with credits, pay those credits only from hosted credits on stealth cards (Corsair / Lampades / Baker).

rfgSelf.description: Remove this card from the game as a cost (The Back). Engine snapshots hosted counters before RFG.

trashEntireGrip.description: Citadel Sanctuary: trash all cards from grip as a cost (legal even when grip is empty).

advancementTokens.description: Spend hosted advancement tokens from this card as a cost (Drago Ivanov).

coreDamage.description: Suffer this much core damage as a cost (Light the Fire!).

tags.description: Take this many tags as a cost (Eru Ayase-Pessoa). Always payable.

removeTags.description: Remove this many Runner tags as a cost (B-1001). Payable only when the Runner has at least that many tags.

creditsPerEncounterSubroutine.description: Pay this many credits per subroutine on the encountered ice (Physarum Entangler).

powerCountersEqualEncounterStrength.description: Spend hosted power counters equal to the effective strength of the ice being encountered (Baklan Bochkin).

trashInstalledProgramUnlessOwnInstalledT.description: Simulchip: trash 1 installed program as an additional cost unless the Runner already trashed an installed card this turn.

forfeitAgenda.description: Forfeit 1 scored agenda as a cost (Data Dealer).

trashProgramFromGrip.description: Monolith: trash a program from grip as a cost.

minCreditsFromStealth.description: Houdini: at least this many of the credit cost must be spent from stealth cards.

netDamage.description: Suffer this much net damage as a cost (Zer0).

forbidDuringRun.description: Advanced Assembly Lines: ability cannot be used during a run.

onlyDuringHqRun.description: Ability usable only during a run on HQ (Panic Button).

onlyDuringArchivesRun.description: Ability usable only during a run on Archives (Defense Construct).

requiresSuccessfulAllCentralsThisTurn.description: Ability usable only if successful runs on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn (The Wizard's Chest).

formicaryApproachAnyServer.description: Unrezzed ice ability legal at approach_server_paw for any approached server (Formicary).

requireFullyBrokenThisEncounter.description: Usable only if the Runner fully broke the encountered ice this encounter (Crescentus).

requireSufferedCorpDamageThisTurn.description: First Responders: usable only if the Runner suffered damage from a Corp card ability this turn.

requireSufferedMeatDamageThisTurn.description: Officer Frank: usable only if the Runner suffered meat damage this turn.

requireSufferedAnyDamageThisTurn.description: Usable only if the Runner suffered any amount of damage this turn.

requireNextPawAfterDamage.description: Salvaged Vanadis Armory: usable only during the next paid ability window after suffering any amount of damage.

hostStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify host ice strength by this amount (Monkeywrench).

rezAsNonIceDuringRunsOnServer.description: During runs against this ice's server, may rez this ice any time non-ice cards could be rezzed (Rime).

otherIceProtectingServerStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify strength of each other ice protecting the same server (Monkeywrench).

onFirstHardwareInstallEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner installs a piece of hardware (Masterwork v37).

onFirstCorpCardTrashEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner trashes a Corp card (Solidarity Badge).

onFirstProgramOrHardwareTrashEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn a program or piece of hardware is trashed from any location while this card is installed (District 99).

onFirstAccessTrashEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner trashes a card they are accessing while this card is installed (Mâché). Engine supplies the trashed card's trash cost for add_power_counter_equal_to_last_access_trash_cost.

onAccessTrash.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner trashes a card they are accessing (Audrey v2).

onFirstCorpRootInstallEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Corp installs a card in a server root (Lago Paranoá Shelter).

onAccessRequiresRezzed.description: When true, onAccess fires only while this card is rezzed (Angelique Garza Correa).

onPassHost.description: Effect IR when the Runner passes the ice hosting this card (Pichação).

hostedCreditsOnAnyIceRez.description: Place this many hosted credits when any ice is rezzed (Cybersand Harvester; Ice Analyzer while installed).

hostedCreditsSpendFor.description: Spend non-recurring hosted credits for these purposes (Cybersand install; Bahia Bands trash; Mystic Maemi play_event).

hostedCreditsSpendForInstallTypes.description: When set with hostedCreditsSpendFor install, hosted credits apply only to installs of these card types (Ice Analyzer: program).

paidAbilitiesOncePerTurn.description: At most one paid ability on this card may be used each turn (Kati Jones).

iceRezCostReductionProtectingThisServer.description: While rezzed, lower rez cost of each ice protecting this server by this many credits (Vovô Ozetti).

rootRezCostReductionThisServerIfThreat.description: Threat N → while rezzed, lower rez cost of each card in this server's root by amount (Vovô Ozetti).

onCorpTurnEnd.description: Effect IR when the Corp's turn ends while this card is rezzed in a server root, or while scored in the Corp score area (Vovô Ozetti may-move; Jumon).

corpLosesCreditsOnCreateServer.description: Whenever the Corp creates a server, they lose this many credits (Hijacked Router).

iceGainsTrashToResolveChosenSubOnEncount.description: While rezzed: each ice protecting this server gains encounter ability — choose 1 subroutine; may trash the ice to resolve it (ZATO City Grid).

firstEncounterSubsBecomeNetDamage.description: While installed: during the first encounter each turn with ice protecting the server named via may_choose_server / namedServerId, each subroutine resolves as Do N net damage instead (Tsakhia Bankhar Gantulga).

trashWhenNoHostedCards.description: When this card has no hosted cards remaining, trash it (Asmund Pudlat).

onBreakSubroutine.description: Effect IR fired after any subroutine is broken while this card is installed (e3 Feedback Implants-class).

onBreakSubroutineMayPayCreditsBreakAnoth.description: After any subroutine is broken, may pay this many credits to break another subroutine on the encountered ice (e3 Feedback Implants).

strengthBonusOnBreakSubForRun.description: When this icebreaker breaks a subroutine, gain this much strength for the remainder of the run (Snowball).

installedCardsTrashCostBonus.description: While rezzed: increase the trash cost of all installed cards by this amount (Encryption Protocol).

mayImmediatelyRezIceOnInstallProtectingT.description: Amazon Industrial Zone: whenever Corp installs ice protecting this server, may immediately rez it lowering rez cost by this amount.

onSuccessfulRunOncePerTurn.description: When true, onSuccessfulRun fires at most once per turn for this instance (e.g. first successful run on the mark).

mustRevealWhenAccessedFromRd.description: Static ability: while accessing this card in R&D, the Runner must reveal it (CR §1.21.7).

skipOnAccessFromArchives.description: When true, onAccess does not fire if this card is accessed from Archives (Snare!, Behold!).

onFirstTagThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner is tagged each turn (identities).

onTakeTagsWhenUntagged.description: Runner identity: Effect IR when taking 1+ tags while previously untagged (Sebastião).

connectionBasicTrashAdditionalCostTrashH.description: As additional cost for Corp basic trash of a connection resource, trash 1 from HQ (Sebastião).

onEncounterEndIfRezzedThisTurn.description: Effect IR when an encounter with this ice ends if it was rezzed this turn (Cloud Eater).

onAfterOperationOrExpendable.description: Corp identity: Effect IR after resolving an operation or expendable card action (Nuvem).

creditsOnFirstRdTrashThisTurn.description: Corp identity: gain N¢ the first time each turn a card is trashed from R&D (Nuvem).

onFirstPassRezzedCodeGateOrSentryThisTur.description: Scored agenda: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed code gate or sentry (Sisyphus).

onRunBeginMaySpendAgendaCounterRezUpToIc.description: Scored: on run begin may spend agenda counter to rez up to N ice protecting attacked (Lightning Laboratory).

onCorpTurnEndDerezUpToIceProtectingLight.description: Scored: Corp turn end derez up to N ice protecting Lightning's remembered server.

oncePerTurnOnRezIceProtectingThisServerD.description: Brasília: once/turn when ice rezzed protecting this server during a run, may derez another for +N strength.

onRezApOrDestroyerIceDuringRun.description: Thunderbolt: when rez AP/destroyer ice during a run, +strength and grant ETR-unless-trash sub.

derezAtAnyTurnEnd.description: While rezzed, derez this card when any turn ends (Lycian Multi-Munition).

onFirstCoreDamageThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner suffers core damage each turn (Runner identities; CR §10.4.2b).

onFirstRdRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner begins a run on R&D each turn (Runner identities; e.g. Padma may charge).

onFirstArchivesRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn a run on Archives begins while this card is rezzed (Front Company).

rezOnlyDuringCorpTurn.description: May only rez this card during the Corp's turn (Front Company).

firstRunCannotTargetRemote.description: While rezzed, the first run each turn cannot target a remote server (Front Company).

persistent.description: Abilities remain active while installed even if unrezzed (Tucana / Daniela).

stealAdditionalCostFromProtectingServer.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when the Runner steals an agenda from this server (Daniela Persistent).

stealAdditionalClicks.description: Additional clicks the Runner must spend to steal this agenda (Méliès City Luxury Line).

stealAdditionalCredits.description: Additional credits the Runner must pay to steal this agenda (Bellona).

stealAdditionalCreditsWhileRezzed.description: While this card is rezzed, Runner must pay this many credits as an additional cost to steal any agenda (Magistrate Revontulet).

stealAdditionalCreditsFromProtectingServ.description: While this card is rezzed (or Persistent), Runner must pay this many credits as an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root (Red Herrings).

runnerLoseCreditsOnBreakPrintedSubroutin.description: Whenever the Runner breaks a printed subroutine on this ice, they lose this many credits (Gold Farmer).

playCostDiscountPerIceProtectingServer.description: Reduce this card's play cost by 1 for each piece of ice protecting the named server (Tailgate).

maxRemoteServers.description: Corp identity: maximum number of remote servers (A Teia / Earth Station).

hqUnflipped.description: Additional credits to initiate a run on HQ while identity is unflipped (Earth Station).

remoteFlipped.description: Additional credits to initiate a run on a remote while identity is flipped (Earth Station).

additionalRunInitiateCredits.description: Corp identity: additional credit cost to initiate a run, gated by face (Earth Station; CR 1.16.1b / 4.6.8f).

clicks.description: Clicks per hosted power counter as additional cost to initiate a run on this server (Cold Site).

additionalRunInitiateClicks.description: Rezzed upgrade: flat additional click cost to initiate a run on this server (Ruhr Valley).

onSuccessfulRunEnd.description: Whenever a successful run ends, evaluate this effect while rezzed (Dedicated Response Team; typically gated by runner_tagged).

max.description: Maximum credits that may be spent on rez to place that many power counters (Reduced Service).

rezSpendCreditsForPowerCounters.description: When this card is rezzed, Corp may pay up to max credits to place that many power counters (Reduced Service; Atman install cousin).

onApproachServerOncePerRun.description: Fire onApproachServer only the first time the Runner approaches this server each run (Letheia Nisei).

blankIdentitiesWhileResolving.description: While resolving this event (including any run it starts), each player's identity loses all abilities (Direct Access).

onFirstTrashMatchingRunnerIdentityFactio.description: Effect IR the first time each turn you trash a card whose faction matches the Runner identity's faction, from any location (Storgotic Resonator).

onFirstRevealEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn this card's controller reveals a card (Hyoubu Institute).

onWouldDrawOncePerTurn.description: Interrupt Effect IR the first time each turn the controller would draw any number of cards (The Class Act).

playRequiresRunnerAgendaPointsGte.description: Play only if the Runner has at least this many agenda points (Complete Image).

mirrormorphOnThirdDistinctAction.description: Corp identity: when the third action of the turn completes, if the first three actions were each different kinds, resolve this Effect IR (MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration).

vacheronStealReplacement.description: When this agenda would be added to the Runner score area from anywhere except Archives, instead add it with 4 agenda counters (Project Vacheron; CR 9.9.9c). Replacement does not re-trigger on its own result.

worthZeroAgendaPointsWhileHasAgendaCount.description: While in the Runner score area with ≥1 agenda counters, contribute 0 agenda points (Project Vacheron).

onFirstHardwareUseDuringRunEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner uses (resolves a paid ability on) installed hardware during a run while this card is installed (The Back).

onCorpAbilityCausesRunnerSpendOrLoseCred.description: Corp identity: Effect IR whenever a Corp card ability causes the Runner to spend or lose ≥1¢ during a run — once per aggregate payment/lose instruction (GameNET; CR 1.16.2b).

onFirstRemoteInstallThisTurn.description: Identity: Effect IR the first time each turn Corp installs on a remote root or protecting ice (A Teia).

onFirstRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn a run begins while this card is scored or installed (Stegodon / Knickknack / Prognostic Q-Loop).

onApproachIce.description: Effect IR when the Runner approaches ice protecting this server (rezzed upgrade in root; Mitra Aman).

identityFlippedHooks.description: Corp dual/multi-faced identity: effects while flipped (Nebula / Méliès U).

onFlipToBackIfRunMatchesFace.description: When flipping to back during a run on the secretly-set central (Méliès U).

onRunnerDiscardOverMaxHand.description: Runner identity: Effect IR after discarding to max hand size, with discarded batch available (Magdalene).

onRunnerActionPhaseEnd.description: Effect IR when the Runner's action phase ends while this card is installed (Cacophony).

onAnyIceRez.description: Whenever Corp rezzes ice while this card is the Runner identity or installed in the Runner's rig (Barry Wong / Compromised Employee).

serverRootAssetTrashCostBonus.description: Mahkota: +N trash cost for assets in this server's root.

playRequiresNoCorpActionFinished.description: Corp operation: play only before the first Corp action completes (Petty Cash).

playRequiresNoActiveLockdown.description: Corp lockdown operation: play only if no lockdown is active in corp:play-area (CR §3.5.1c / SYNC Rerouting et al.).
